alt.en: The paper describes checking language-model proposals and storing rules for reuse. Its arXiv abstract reports performance gains, but does not establish how a deployed system’s evolving configuration can be checked.
alt.zh: 论文提出检查语言模型的规划建议，再将规则存入记忆以供复用。arXiv 摘要报告了性能提升，但未说明外部人员如何核查部署系统持续变化的配置。
